content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

The current digital commerce landscape is dominated by a few major players, with Stripe operating in only 46 countries out of 195 globally. This exclusion limits access for countless creators in Nigeria and other restricted regions. By understanding the alternatives available, creators can establish their own online presence and maintain control over their income. This infrastructure shift not only enables creators to sell freely but also protects them from arbitrary platform restrictions that can lead to account suspensions or frozen funds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure leverages a combination of free and paid tools to enable creators to set up fully operational online stores. By using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can build their storefronts without relying on traditional payment processors. This architecture ensures that all transactions are processed through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing creators to accept payments without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This includes artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other similar markets. By providing these creators with the necessary tools and resources, we empower them to bypass the financial exclusion imposed by traditional platforms, allowing them to monetize their creations and retain full ownership of their data and transactions.
Control your digital sales without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that work in harmony. Hosting is taken care of through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Order storage is facilitated via Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery utilizes Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This interconnected system ensures that creators can efficiently manage their products and payments, all while maintaining ownership and sovereignty over their digital assets.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your sovereign commerce setup, first choose the appropriate stack based on your needs. Next, sign up for a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate your order management system with Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure your file delivery mechanism. With these steps, you can establish a robust online presence without relying on restricted payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

To sell digital products without Stripe in your country, consider implementing a sovereign commerce stack. This architecture allows you to use free tools for hosting, payment processing with NOWPayments, and file delivery without relying on traditional payment platforms that exclude your region. This approach ensures you maintain full control over your transactions and data.
Build your store with free tools and retain full ownership.

For those seeking to navigate the limitations of platforms like Gumroad or PayPal, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides comprehensive documentation and guidance on setting up your own sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more resources to empower your digital sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

You can sell digital products by implementing a sovereign commerce stack that utilizes free hosting and payment processing tools. This allows you to create a fully functional online store without relying on Stripe or PayPal.

PayPal may not be fully accessible in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, and even if you have an account, suspensions can lead to frozen funds for up to 180 days. Exploring sovereign commerce options is a safer route.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose from a wide range of options for accepting payments. This flexibility enables you to cater to a broader audience without traditional restrictions.

Yes, purchasing a sovereign commerce stack includes 30 days of support, ensuring you have access to assistance as you set up and manage your online store.
